name: foreman
description: Run Claude Code as a software team: architect, implementer, reviewer, and qa roles under a lead that reports to you.

keep_awake.title: Keep the Mac awake
keep_awake.description: Run caffeinate for the life of each session so unattended work is not cut short by idle sleep.

auto_pr.title: Push and open the draft PR at Gate 2 without asking
auto_pr.description: When off, the lead presents the branch at Gate 2 and asks you before pushing or opening the pull request.

notifications.title: Desktop notifications
notifications.description: Show a banner when Claude Code needs a permission decision or the lead needs you. Off silences the banner and nothing else.
